description:
Deal combat damage using the creature with Celestial Mantle attached, triggering Celestial Mantle, doubling your life total.
At the beginning of your end step, Defiling Daemogoth triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you've lost this turn.

uses.name: Celestial Mantle
uses.cardState: attached to a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent
